globals.name: accesskey
globals.description: Keyboard shortcut to activate or focus element

globals.name: anchor
globals.description: Associates the element with an anchor element for CSS anchor positioning.

globals.name: autofocus
globals.description: Automatically focus the element when the page is loaded

globals.name: class
globals.description: Classes to which the element belongs

globals.name: exportparts
globals.description: Re-exports named shadow parts of a nested shadow tree to the outer tree for ::part() styling.

globals.name: headingreset
globals.description: Prevents a heading offset computation from traversing beyond the element with the attribute

globals.name: nonce
globals.description: Cryptographic nonce used in Content Security Policy checks [CSP]

globals.name: part
globals.description: Names the element so it can be targeted by the ::part() pseudo-element from outside its shadow tree.

globals.name: tabindex
globals.description: Whether the element is focusable and sequentially focusable, and the relative order of the element for the purposes of sequential focus navigation

globals.name: virtualkeyboardpolicy
globals.description: Controls whether the on-screen virtual keyboard shows automatically on focus.

aria.name: role
aria.description: The WAI-ARIA role that defines the type of this element for assistive technologies.

aria.name: aria-activedescendant
aria.description: Identifies the currently active descendant of a composite widget.

aria.name: aria-atomic
aria.description: Whether assistive technologies present the entire changed live region as a whole.

aria.name: aria-autocomplete
aria.description: What kind of user-input completion suggestions the widget provides.

aria.name: aria-braillelabel
aria.description: A braille label overriding the accessible name for braille displays.

aria.name: aria-brailleroledescription
aria.description: A human-readable braille description of the element role.

aria.name: aria-busy
aria.description: Whether an element and its subtree are currently being updated.

aria.name: aria-checked
aria.description: The checked state of checkboxes, radio buttons and other toggle widgets.

aria.name: aria-colcount
aria.description: The total number of columns in a table, grid or treegrid.

aria.name: aria-colindex
aria.description: The column index of an element relative to the total number of columns.

aria.name: aria-colspan
aria.description: The number of columns spanned by a cell or gridcell.

aria.name: aria-controls
aria.description: Identifies the element(s) whose contents or presence this element controls.

aria.name: aria-current
aria.description: The current item within a set of related elements.

aria.name: aria-describedby
aria.description: Identifies the element(s) that describe this element.

aria.name: aria-description
aria.description: A string value that describes or annotates the current element.

aria.name: aria-details
aria.description: Identifies the element that provides a detailed, extended description.

aria.name: aria-disabled
aria.description: Whether the element is perceivable but disabled and not editable or operable.

aria.name: aria-dropeffect
aria.description: What functions can be performed when a dragged object is released (deprecated).

aria.name: aria-errormessage
aria.description: Identifies the element that provides an error message for this element.

aria.name: aria-expanded
aria.description: Whether a grouping element owned or controlled by this element is expanded.

aria.name: aria-flowto
aria.description: The next element(s) in an alternate reading order of content.

aria.name: aria-grabbed
aria.description: The grabbed state of an element in a drag-and-drop operation (deprecated).

aria.name: aria-haspopup
aria.description: Whether the element has a popup, and the type of popup it triggers.

aria.name: aria-hidden
aria.description: Whether the element is exposed to the accessibility API.

aria.name: aria-invalid
aria.description: Whether the entered value does not conform to the expected format.

aria.name: aria-keyshortcuts
aria.description: Keyboard shortcuts that activate or focus the element.

aria.name: aria-label
aria.description: A string value that labels the current element.

aria.name: aria-labelledby
aria.description: Identifies the element(s) that label this element.

aria.name: aria-level
aria.description: The hierarchical level of an element within a structure.

aria.name: aria-live
aria.description: How assistive technologies should announce updates to a live region.

aria.name: aria-modal
aria.description: Whether an element is modal when displayed.

aria.name: aria-multiline
aria.description: Whether a text box accepts multiple lines of input.

aria.name: aria-multiselectable
aria.description: Whether the user may select more than one item from the current selectable descendants.

aria.name: aria-orientation
aria.description: Whether the element's orientation is horizontal, vertical or unknown.

aria.name: aria-owns
aria.description: Identifies child element(s) to define a parent/child relationship the DOM cannot.

aria.name: aria-placeholder
aria.description: A short hint intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value.

aria.name: aria-posinset
aria.description: An element's number or position in the current set of listitems or treeitems.

aria.name: aria-pressed
aria.description: The pressed state of a toggle button.

aria.name: aria-readonly
aria.description: Whether the element is not editable but is otherwise operable.

aria.name: aria-relevant
aria.description: What notifications the user agent triggers when a live region changes.

aria.name: aria-required
aria.description: Whether user input is required on the element before form submission.

aria.name: aria-roledescription
aria.description: A human-readable, author-localized description for the role of an element.

aria.name: aria-rowcount
aria.description: The total number of rows in a table, grid or treegrid.

aria.name: aria-rowindex
aria.description: The row index of an element relative to the total number of rows.

aria.name: aria-rowspan
aria.description: The number of rows spanned by a cell or gridcell.

aria.name: aria-selected
aria.description: The selected state of a selectable element.

aria.name: aria-setsize
aria.description: The number of items in the current set of listitems or treeitems.

aria.name: aria-sort
aria.description: Whether items in a table or grid are sorted in ascending or descending order.

aria.name: aria-valuemax
aria.description: The maximum allowed value for a range widget.

aria.name: aria-valuemin
aria.description: The minimum allowed value for a range widget.

aria.name: aria-valuenow
aria.description: The current value for a range widget.

aria.name: aria-valuetext
aria.description: A human-readable text alternative of the current value of a range widget.
